description: Read a UTF-8 file from an absolute or workspace-relative path. Optional start_line/end_line return a numbered slice; omit both for the full file without line numbers.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive start line. When set, content is a numbered slice.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive end line. When set with start_line, both ends are included.

description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file after governed approval and freshness checks.

content.description: The complete file content to write.

allow_overwrite.description: Set true only when intentionally replacing an existing file after reading it.
